facts.fact: ARTF's director said on 5 October 2026 that article 13 of the 2026 finance law obliges money-transfer operators to register on ARTF's digital platform and declare all transfers by the 10th of the following month, with a fine of 20 million FCFA for refusing to interconnect to the ARTF platform.

systems.owner: ARTF (Agence de régulation des transferts de fonds)

note: The interconnection duty is to the regulator's reporting platform, not between payment providers or to a payment switch, so no reach fact.
